AI development platform LangChain has secured $300 million in a Series C funding round led by CapitalG, bringing its total valuation to $3 billion.

The round follows a 1.25 billion valuation reported in late 2025.

LangChain focuses on orchestration tools for autonomous AI agents, including its LangSmith platform, which currently counts 7,000 enterprise customers such as Nvidia, Toyota, and Salesforce.
